title: 1968: The New Economic Mechanism Experiment
grammar: Proportionality and correlation: arányban áll / van ('is in proportion to') and arányosan
goal: I can explain the principles and impact of the 1968 New Economic Mechanism (Új Gazdasági Mechanizmus).
I can use arányban áll / van and arányosan / aránytalanul to express proportionality and economic correlation.
I can contrast command economy planning with enterprise autonomy and profit motivation.
